name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's meticulous nature and unwavering commitment to precision made him a natural fit for motorsport. He began his career as a mechanical engineer, working on complex machinery in the Swiss watchmaking industry. However, his passion for racing eventually drew him to the world of motorsport, where he saw an opportunity to apply his skills in a more dynamic and exciting environment.

He transitioned into simulator engineering, drawn by the challenge of creating realistic and immersive training environments for drivers. Jean-Pierre believes that a good simulator isn't just about replicating the physics of a car; it's about capturing the nuances of a track and the psychological pressures a driver faces. His dedication to detail and his ability to troubleshoot complex technical problems have made him a valuable asset to any team.

 Jean-Pierre approaches his work with a deep sense of responsibility and a commitment to continuous improvement. He is always looking for new ways to enhance the realism and effectiveness of the simulator, and he is never satisfied with anything less than perfection.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze and a slight stoop from years spent hunched over computer screens.

quirks: Always carries a small Swiss Army knife.
Insists on using metric measurements, even when others use imperial.
Has a habit of muttering technical jargon to himself while working.
